verdict: Doc FrizzleBob cracked the clinical nursing bible open and turned every chapter into a tag-team move. The deck covers the full nursing domain — skin, fluids, airway, emergency, peds, geri, palliative, ethics — without a single gap. Final-the-Vigil-Watcher and Fatigue-the-Burnout-Shadow alone justify the Gumroad listing. Weak spots: a handful of pure-monitoring cards (Output-the-Fluid-Tracker, Albu-the-Protein-Vault) stay clinical rather than embodied. Table-ready: absolutely yes.
blurb: For nurses and nursing students who want to finally remember what they learned. Fifty-six care-strategist cards that turn clinical skills into wrestling moves you can feel — from Code Blue to the death vigil.

notes: 16 pages: 1 cover + 14 card pages (4 cards each) + 1 back/synthesis page. Back page has 3 synthesis scenarios (Septic-Sentinel, Medication-Safety-Lock, Pressure-Prevention) as teaching combo-moves, not counted as cards. BLÖDINN! stamps pp.2-4; KayfaBINGO! pp.4+10; KayfafaBIZARRO! p.6; KayfaBONGO! p.10. Strong thematic arc: assessment→intervention→emergency→hygiene→peds/geri→palliative→team.

Give Bed-the-Environment-Reset a stronger villain consequence

cards.power: The Vulnerability-Scan. Identifies wrestlers with Paper-Armor about to tear from Moisture-Melt or Friction-Burn.
cards.lore: Pressure-sore prevention. If the Stat-Score is low, Skin-Armor falls within hours unless Position-Pivot is played.
cards.gradeReason: Clear scanner role but Braden Scale context needed to fully play it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Anxious bear nurse scanning bony pressure points with magnifying glass. Style: MedKayfab wrestling sketch. Subject: Vulnerability scan. Mood: Alert, clinical.

cards.power: The Silent-Erosion. Strikes from the inside out, using Gravity-Pressure to kill Blood-Roads.
cards.lore: Ischemic tissue death. When still, Capillary-Pipes are crushed against Bone-Pillars.
cards.gradeReason: Villain card with vivid horror but needs pressure ulcer staging knowledge to embody.
cards.artworkPrompt: Grotesque tentacled plant monster eating through flesh layers from underneath. Style: MedKayfab gothic horror. Subject: Pressure ulcer stages. Mood: Creeping dread.

cards.power: The Pressure-Redistribution. Shifts Gravity-Load away from Bony-Peaks, restoring the Ischemia-Time.
cards.lore: Restoring perfusion. Changing the angle allows crushed capillaries to Refill-with-Oxygen.
cards.gradeReason: You turn the patient. Immediately embodied. No explanation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Manatee in scrubs rotating patient to 30-degree lateral tilt, sweat on brow. Style: MedKayfab wrestling action. Subject: Repositioning. Mood: Focused, rhythmic.

cards.power: The Moisture-Manager. Sucks away Infection-Fluid, keeping the wound Moist-but-not-Drowned.
cards.lore: Promoting granulation. Needs a Tropical-Environment (Warm/Moist), but Too-Much-Swamp (Maceration) destroys edges.
cards.gradeReason: Wound moisture balance is nuanced; needs wound care training to embody correctly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Duck-billed creature in gloves applying wound dressing, balancing moisture droplets. Style: MedKayfab educational. Subject: Wound exudate management. Mood: Precise, careful.

cards.power: The Deterioration-Radar. Aggregates Small-Stat-Glitches to predict a System-Crash hours before it happens.
cards.lore: Pattern recognition. Three abnormal stats equal a Sepsis-Storm approaching.
cards.gradeReason: Strong concept but acronym-based scoring requires clinical context to operate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Owl with radar dish head surveying vital signs, SYSTEM-CRASH alert blinking red. Style: MedKayfab tech-thriller. Subject: Early warning score. Mood: Urgent, watchful.

cards.power: The Wrong-Pipe-Blocker. Ensures Food-and-Saliva go to the Gut-Arena, preventing infiltration.
cards.lore: Preventing Aspiration Pneumonia. Vital for Stroke-Stalls or Dementia-Daze.
cards.gradeReason: Wrong pipe, right guardian — the role is viscerally clear and immediately playable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Frog blocking bronchial tube entrance with arms outstretched while food arrows veer toward stomach. Style: MedKayfab anatomical. Subject: Aspiration prevention. Mood: Urgent vigilance.

cards.power: The Balance-Guardian. Measures every Drop-In and Drop-Out to spot the Kidney-Fortress-Stall.
cards.lore: Fluid hemodynamics. Zero-Balance is the goal; excess Input brings Edema-the-Swelling.
cards.gradeReason: Counting drops is hard to embody theatrically — monitoring task described more than performed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Beaver with clipboard tallying IV drip buckets against urine output jugs on a balance scale. Style: MedKayfab accounting. Subject: Fluid balance tracking. Mood: Methodical, numerical.

cards.power: The Mind-Fog-Detection. Spots when the Wrestler begins Pulling-on-Tubes and Talking-to-Ghosts.
cards.lore: Acute Brain Failure. Early detection saves the brain from long-term Damage-Scars.
cards.gradeReason: Pulling tubes, talking to ghosts — immediately embodied chaos. Best name in first half.
cards.artworkPrompt: Confused fox in hospital gown surrounded by ghost apparitions, pulling at IV line. Style: MedKayfab surreal horror. Subject: Acute delirium. Mood: Disoriented, urgent.

cards.power: The Pipe-Protector. Ensures the Vein-Bridge is clear and hasn't Infiltrated the Tissue-Arena.
cards.lore: Preventing Extravasation. Leaking chemicals cause Necrosis-the-Melt.
cards.gradeReason: IV line patency is clear to nurses but needs clinical context for full embodiment.
cards.artworkPrompt: Otter in gloves inspecting IV catheter site with flashlight, checking for swelling. Style: MedKayfab technical. Subject: IV patency check. Mood: Alert, protective.

cards.power: The Controlled-Flow. Ensures Chemical-Ally enters Blood-River at the exact Speed-Stat.
cards.lore: Constant serum levels. The Machine prevents Overdose-Overload from Human-Glitches.
cards.gradeReason: Infusion pump concept clear but programming requires hands-on device knowledge.
cards.artworkPrompt: Octopus operating a multi-armed infusion pump, each tentacle controlling a different drip rate. Style: MedKayfab tech. Subject: IV infusion control. Mood: Meticulous, controlled.

cards.power: The Error-Shield. Stops the Wrong-Chemical from entering the Wrestler.
cards.lore: High-reliability organization (HRO) principles. Double-checking defeats Fatigue-the-Brain-Drain.
cards.gradeReason: Every nurse knows the Five Rights — ritual check is immediate and embodied.
cards.artworkPrompt: Eagle in scrubs holding medication against five glowing checklists: Patient, Drug, Dose, Route, Time. Style: MedKayfab ceremonial. Subject: Medication safety rights. Mood: Solemn, precise.

cards.power: The Fuel-Monitor. Pokes the Finger-Sensor to prevent Sugar-Spike-Extremes.
cards.lore: Stress hyperglycemia. Systemic-Riot raises Sugar-Tokens even in non-diabetics.
cards.gradeReason: Finger prick is clear; stress hyperglycemia context adds needed dimension but requires training.
cards.artworkPrompt: Alert creature jabbing a glucometer at a patient's fingertip, meter showing danger zone numbers. Style: MedKayfab monitoring. Subject: Blood glucose surveillance. Mood: Quick, clinical.

cards.power: The Long-and-Leg-Opener. Forces standing to prevent Clot-the-Blocker and Moni-the-Pneumonia.
cards.lore: Disease of Immobile Stasis. Gravity and movement are the best Anti-Clot medications.
cards.gradeReason: Get up and walk — the most embodiable instruction in any hospital.
cards.artworkPrompt: Kangaroo nurse hauling reluctant patient out of bed to stand for the first time. Style: MedKayfab action. Subject: Early mobilization. Mood: Energetic, determined.

cards.power: The Impact-Detector. Identifies Wobbly-Legs before they hit the Arena-Floor and break a Bone-Pillar.
cards.lore: Preventing secondary trauma. A Fall-Fracture-Ring is often more lethal than the original injury.
cards.gradeReason: Villain card every nurse fears — the Wobbly-Leg threat is immediately palpable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Giraffe patient teetering near hospital bed edge, nurse reaching urgently to catch them. Style: MedKayfab threat card. Subject: Fall risk. Mood: Tense, split-second.

cards.power: The Leg-Squeezer. Pulses legs to keep Blood-River moving, stopping Clot-the-Blocker from hiding.
cards.lore: Mimicking the Muscle-Pump. Constant blood breeds PE-the-Clot-Monster.
cards.gradeReason: Sequential compression devices are clear but device-dependent; needs clinical gear context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Caterpillar wrapped around a patient's leg, rhythmically squeezing to push blood upward. Style: MedKayfab mechanical. Subject: DVT compression prevention. Mood: Rhythmic, relentless.

cards.power: The Motivation-Buff. Explains the Match-Plan so the Wrestler stops Fighting-the-Orders.
cards.lore: Health literacy. Knowing 'why' increases intervention success by 5x.
cards.gradeReason: Patient education coaching is clear but softer to embody than procedural cards.
cards.artworkPrompt: Loyal golden retriever nurse sitting with patient at eye level, explaining care plan patiently. Style: MedKayfab warm. Subject: Patient education. Mood: Calm, empowering.

cards.power: The Double-Edged-Drain. Empties the Reservoir but gives Bacteria-Punks a Ladder to the Kidney-Fortress.
cards.lore: Catheter-Associated UTI. The longer the Drain-Snake stays, the higher the Sepsis-Store risk.
cards.gradeReason: Double-edged hero/villain tension is perfectly embodied — you feel the trade-off instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Snake catheter threading through patient with bacteria riding up its back toward kidneys. Style: MedKayfab moral ambiguity. Subject: CAUTI risk. Mood: Uneasy, cautionary.

cards.power: The Motility-Reporter. Alerts the team to the Side-of-the-Slow-Out a Bowel-Block.
cards.lore: Opioid-induced constipation. Pain-Meds freeze the Gut-Arena, leading to Toxic-Back-up.
cards.gradeReason: Raccoon with a poop chart is peak MedKayfab — instantly iconic, zero context needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Sophisticated raccoon in lab coat holding Bristol Stool Chart clipboard, judging a sample gravely. Style: MedKayfab comedy-clinical. Subject: Bowel motility assessment. Mood: Dignified absurdity.

cards.power: The Acid-Shield. Cleans Waste-Leaks and applies Barrier-Cream-Armor to stop Infection-Ian.
cards.lore: Incontinence-Associated Dermatitis. Acid-Waste destroys Skin-Armor, inviting Infection-Ian.
cards.gradeReason: Skin protection role is clear but the specific cream-barrier context is technical.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bear nurse applying protective barrier cream with gauntlet gloves against acid waste splatter. Style: MedKayfab defense. Subject: Incontinence skin care. Mood: Protective, diligent.

cards.power: The Hidden-Pool-Finder. Uses Sono-Rings to see if the Reservoir is still half-full.
cards.lore: Urinary retention. Retained Fluid-Tokens grow Bacteria-Punks and cause Hydro-High-Pressure.
cards.gradeReason: Ultrasound bladder scan is clear once you know the device; needs clinical setup.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bat using echolocation sonar to scan a patient's lower abdomen, detecting hidden urine reservoir. Style: MedKayfab diagnostic. Subject: Post-void residual ultrasound. Mood: Precise, revealing.

cards.power: The Alveoli-Pop. Forces a Deep-Vast-Breath to pop open Collapsed-Lung-Balloons (Atelectasis).
cards.lore: Preventing Post-Op-Pneumonia. Exercises the Diaphragm-Engine and clears Mucus-Gunk.
cards.gradeReason: Breathing device requires a prop to embody; the lung-popping metaphor is vivid but device-tethered.
cards.artworkPrompt: Pufferfish inflating incentive spirometer to maximum, lung balloons popping open joyfully around it. Style: MedKayfab respiratory. Subject: Spirometry exercise. Mood: Triumphant effort.

cards.power: The Airway-Clearer. Removes Mucus-Gunk blocking the Oxygen-Flow in the Windpipe-Funnel.
cards.lore: Maintaining patency. Gunk becomes a Nursery for Bacteria-Punks and blocks Gas-Exchange.
cards.gradeReason: Sucking gunk from an airway is viscerally, instantly clear. Best respiratory card in deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Vacuum creature with suction-cup mouth clearing thick green mucus from a bronchial tube tunnel. Style: MedKayfab visceral. Subject: Airway suctioning. Mood: Aggressive, decisive.

cards.power: The Atmospheric-Buff. Increases Oxygen-Percentage so Red-Cabs-Trucks load more fuel.
cards.lore: Correcting Hypoxia. Warning: too much Oxygen-Fire can stop the Drive-to-Breathe in COPD-Chris.
cards.gradeReason: Oxygen dial is clear but the COPD hypoxic drive caveat adds critical nuance requiring training.
cards.artworkPrompt: Eagle adjusting oxygen flow dial on tank while red blood cell trucks load up at lungs below. Style: MedKayfab respiratory. Subject: Oxygen therapy titration. Mood: Careful adjustment.

cards.power: The Balloon-Support. Uses Constant-Air-Pressure to stop Lung-Balloons from snapping shut.
cards.lore: Improving oxygenation. Stints airways open and pushes Down-Water back into the Blood-River.
cards.gradeReason: CPAP concept is clear but mask-fitting and pressure-setting requires hands-on training.
cards.artworkPrompt: Deep-sea diver creature in CPAP mask, pressure waves holding collapsing lung balloons open from inside. Style: MedKayfab pressure. Subject: CPAP therapy. Mood: Sustained force, relief.

cards.power: The Subjective-Signal. Translates the Wrestler's-Internal-Scream into a number for Pharmacy-Dose.
cards.lore: The Fifth-Vital-Sign. "Pain is whatever the patient says it is," driving the Comfort-Match.
cards.gradeReason: Pain scale universally known but 'translate scream to number' still requires clinical framing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Chameleon nurse holding 0-10 pain scale ruler, translating patient's grimace into a number. Style: MedKayfab empathic. Subject: Numeric pain rating. Mood: Attentive, compassionate.

cards.power: The Self-Dose-Trigger. Allows the Wrestler to summon a Pain-Mute-Ally when the Scream-Stat spikes.
cards.lore: Autonomy in pain control. Keeps the Nociceptor-Alarm.
cards.gradeReason: Press the button, get relief — patient agency at its most visceral and immediate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Cat patient pressing a large glowing demand button with one paw, pain relief energy surging through IV line. Style: MedKayfab empowerment. Subject: Patient-controlled analgesia. Mood: Decisive, relief.

cards.power: The Energy-Drainer. Forces the Wrestler to hyper-ventilate and waste Energy-Tokens on fear.
cards.lore: Sympathetic over-drive. Anxiety mimics Physical-Pain and respiratory distress, confusing the Diagnostic-Engine.
cards.gradeReason: Anxiety as a whirlwind antagonist is immediately felt and embodied — every nurse has played against this.
cards.artworkPrompt: Anxious hare spinning in a windstorm of fear, hyperventilating, energy tokens scattering. Style: MedKayfab emotional villain. Subject: Anxiety agitation. Mood: Frantic, draining.

cards.power: The Human-Armor. Protects the Mind-Armor from being broken by the Hospital-Machine.
cards.lore: Holistic care. Preserving dignity accelerates Healing and boosts the Adherence-Stat.
cards.gradeReason: Pull the curtain, cover the patient, protect the human — immediately embodied.
cards.artworkPrompt: Peacock spreading magnificent tail feathers as a privacy curtain around a vulnerable patient. Style: MedKayfab noble. Subject: Patient dignity and privacy. Mood: Protective, dignified.

cards.power: The Direct-Fuel-Line. Bypasses the Mouth-Gate to deliver Liquid-Energy-Tokens.
cards.lore: Enteral Nutrition. "If the gut works, use it." Keeps Gut-Wallpaper alive and prevents Bacteria-Translocation.
cards.gradeReason: Feeding tube as snake is viscerally clear — the bypassing-the-mouth route is immediately understood.
cards.artworkPrompt: Green snake threading carefully through nostril down to stomach basin, carrying nutritional tokens. Style: MedKayfab anatomical. Subject: Nasogastric tube feeding. Mood: Careful, life-sustaining.

cards.power: The Intravenous-Nourisher. Delivers Everything-the-Body-Needs directly into the Blood-River.
cards.lore: High risk. Beware infections at the Line-Bridge and sudden Sugar-Stat-Glitches.
cards.gradeReason: Blood feast as IV nutrition is dramatic and instantly clear — feeding directly into veins is unforgettable.
cards.artworkPrompt: Spider hanging from a central line, injecting all nutrients directly into a blood river flowing below. Style: MedKayfab gothic nutrition. Subject: Total parenteral nutrition. Mood: Dramatic, life-critical.

cards.power: The Texture-Modifier. Turns Water-Tokens into Honey-Sludge to stop leaks from Lung-Balloons.
cards.lore: Altered swallow mechanics. Thicker fluids move slower, giving the Epiglottis-Gate time to close the Airway-Tunnel.
cards.gradeReason: Thickening fluids is specific — needs speech-path context and IDDSI chart knowledge.
cards.artworkPrompt: Tortoise carefully pouring water into honey consistency before offering it to a patient. Style: MedKayfab careful. Subject: Dysphagia thickened fluids. Mood: Slow, deliberate, protective.

cards.power: The Repair-Material. Provides the Bricks needed to fix the Wrestler-Frame.
cards.lore: Nutritional status. Low Albumin means Body-Storage is empty; the Healing-Clock stalls.
cards.gradeReason: Albumin as lab value is hard to perform — more biomarker than move, describing rather than inviting.
cards.artworkPrompt: Beaver stacking protein bricks to rebuild a crumbling wrestler frame, albumin meter reading low. Style: MedKayfab construction. Subject: Nutritional albumin status. Mood: Urgent repair.

cards.power: The Backup-Brawl. The Elite-Squad called in to fix the Match before the Code-Blue-Siren.
cards.lore: Early intervention. Prevents the Cardiac-Halt by catching Hypoxia or Sepsis early.
cards.gradeReason: Call in the cavalry — the RRT summon is an immediate, dramatic, clear action nurses live by.
cards.artworkPrompt: Elite squad of animals in scrubs sprinting down hospital corridor toward a flickering patient room. Style: MedKayfab rescue action. Subject: Rapid response team activation. Mood: Urgent, coordinated.

cards.power: The Resurrection-Attempt. A Team-Emergency using Electric-Smashes and Chest-Pushes to Reboot-the-Engine.
cards.lore: Cardiac Arrest protocol (ACLS). Every second of Half-Time starves the Brain-Bunker.
cards.gradeReason: CODE BLUE is the most dramatic card in the deck — every player knows exactly what happens next.
cards.artworkPrompt: Blaring siren animal with flashing red light above arrest scene, team scrambling around flatlined monitor. Style: MedKayfab emergency peak. Subject: Code Blue cardiac arrest. Mood: Explosive crisis.

cards.power: The Hand-Powered-Heart. The Care-Strategist becomes the Pump, physically forcing blood to the Brain.
cards.lore: Maintaining perfusion. Without pumping, the Oxygen-Tank empties in 4 minutes.
cards.gradeReason: Hands on chest, push down. The most physically immediate nursing action in existence.
cards.artworkPrompt: Gorilla in scrubs doing deep chest compressions on patient with maximum force, sweat flying. Style: MedKayfab brute force. Subject: CPR compressions. Mood: Ferocious, focused.

cards.power: The System-Reset. A Massive-Lightning-Bolt stops the Chaos-Quiver (V-fib) so the SA-Node-Drummer regains control.
cards.lore: Depolarizing the myocardium to restart a coordinated rhythm.
cards.gradeReason: Clear! Everyone stand back, discharge! The most dramatic button press in medicine.
cards.artworkPrompt: Electric eel nurse pressing defibrillator paddles to patient's chest, lightning bolt arcing across the heart. Style: MedKayfab electric drama. Subject: Defibrillation. Mood: Explosive, reset.

cards.power: The Pathogen-Slayer. Kills Bacteria-Punks on the Skin-Armor before they infiltrate the Incision-Breach.
cards.lore: Reducing Bioburden. CHG leaves a Residual-Kill shield lasting 24 hours.
cards.gradeReason: CHG bathing is clear in intent but requires ICU/surgical context to understand why it matters.
cards.artworkPrompt: Hippo receiving a full chlorhexidine scrub bath pre-op, bacteria punks fleeing the antiseptic foam. Style: MedKayfab decontamination. Subject: CHG pre-operative bath. Mood: Thorough, protective.

cards.power: The Pneumonia-Prevention. Scrubs the Mouth-Arena so Bacteria-Punks can't drip down the Vent-Tube.
cards.lore: Preventing VAP. The mouth is the primary Nursery for lethal ICU lung infections.
cards.gradeReason: Mouth care is clear but VAP prevention context required — most resonant in ICU setting.
cards.artworkPrompt: Crocodile receiving thorough toothbrush scrubbing by a nurse, bacteria pouring out of gum pockets. Style: MedKayfab hygiene. Subject: VAP prevention oral care. Mood: Meticulous.

cards.power: The U-Storm-Protector. Keeps the Lower-Exit-Arena clean to stop Fecal-Bacteria-Punks from migrating.
cards.lore: Preventing UTIs. Proper Clean-Moves are the first line of defense against ascending infections.
cards.gradeReason: Perineal care direction is clear but requires clinical knowledge of front-to-back technique.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ring-tailed lemur nurse performing meticulous perineal care front-to-back, bacteria rerouted downward. Style: MedKayfab prevention. Subject: Perineal infection prevention. Mood: Precise, dignified.

cards.power: The Comfort-and-Skin-Buff. Keeps the Arena-Floor is Wrinkle-Free to prevent Shear-Friction-Burns.
cards.lore: Maintaining skin integrity. A Dirty-Wet Arena grows Bacteria-Punks and breaks Skin-Armor.
cards.gradeReason: Linen change is a task not a move — the card describes an action rather than inviting a role.
cards.artworkPrompt: Swan in crisp white scrubs stretching hospital bed sheets perfectly flat, removing every wrinkle. Style: MedKayfab domestic ritual. Subject: Linen change and skin protection. Mood: Pristine, careful.

cards.power: The Non-Verbal-Translator. Watches the Baby-Wrestler's physical cues to gauge the Internal-Scream.
cards.lore: Pediatric pain assessment. Turns Behavior into Stat-Numbers to drive the Comfort-Move.
cards.gradeReason: Reading a baby's face, legs, cry — the watching role is immediately embodied and human.
cards.artworkPrompt: Koala nurse with magnifying glass watching a tiny baby wrestler's face, legs, and cry with intense focus. Style: MedKayfab pediatric. Subject: FLACC pain observation. Mood: Gentle, watchful.

cards.power: The Anchor-Buff. Provides a Security-Shield that neutralizes the Baby-Wrestler's fear.
cards.lore: Reducing trauma. Healing accelerates when the Social-Anchor is in the ring.
cards.gradeReason: Parent in the ring with the child — you hold them, you are the anchor. Plays instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bear parent in wrestling corner holding frightened bear cub, security shield radiating outward. Style: MedKayfab family-centered. Subject: Parental presence in pediatric care. Mood: Warm, fierce.

cards.power: The Liquid-Level-Radar. Checks if the Baby-Wrestler is Drying-out.
cards.lore: Pediatric fluid balance. Small Fluid Tanks mean they Crash-from-Drying faster than adults.
cards.gradeReason: Wet diapers and fontanelle check is clear for pediatric nurses, less so without that background.
cards.artworkPrompt: Camel nurse checking baby's fontanelle, counting wet diapers, reading small fluid tank gauge. Style: MedKayfab pediatric. Subject: Pediatric hydration assessment. Mood: Careful, urgent.

cards.power: The Brain-Bunker-Hack. Uses Bubbles/Toys so the brain doesn't register the Needle-Strike Pain-Signal.
cards.lore: Gate Control Theory. Competing Fun-Signals Closes-the-Gate on Pain-Signals.
cards.gradeReason: Blow bubbles, the child forgets the needle — most joyful, immediately playable card in the deck.
cards.artworkPrompt: Playful dolphin blowing rainbow bubbles at a child patient, pain signal gates slamming shut in brain. Style: MedKayfab playful. Subject: Non-pharmacological distraction. Mood: Joyful, surprisingly effective.

cards.power: The Fragility-Shield. Treats Silver-Wrestler skin like Wet-Tissue-Paper, using only Silicone-Tape to prevent Tape-Rips.
cards.lore: Atrophic skin. The Skin-Armor loses its Grip, peeling with slight Friction.
cards.gradeReason: Silicone tape substitution is smart but specific — requires geriatric skin knowledge.
cards.artworkPrompt: Old tortoise nurse gently applying silicone tape to paper-thin elderly skin, handling it like wet tissue paper. Style: MedKayfab geriatric. Subject: Atrophic skin tear prevention. Mood: Extreme gentleness.

cards.power: The Interaction-Scanner. Finds the Chemical-Saboteurs in the Bag-of-Pills causing Daze-Confusion.
cards.lore: Adverse drug events. Slow-Kidney-Filters allow medications to build up to Toxic-Levels.
cards.gradeReason: Owl auditing pills for chemical saboteurs is immediately embodied — the detective role clicks at once.
cards.artworkPrompt: Wise owl in reading glasses scrutinizing medication bottles through a Beers Criteria magnifying glass. Style: MedKayfab investigative. Subject: Polypharmacy review. Mood: Scholarly, suspicious.

cards.power: The Arena-Boundary-Guard. Ensures the Dementia-Daze wrestler doesn't wander into the Danger-Zone.
cards.lore: Patient safety. Forgetting where the Ring is can lead straight into a Cold-Trauma-Match.
cards.gradeReason: Stopping a confused patient from wandering out the door — immediate, physical, urgent action.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bloodhound nurse blocking a hallway exit as a confused elderly patient in pajamas tries to wander through. Style: MedKayfab boundary. Subject: Dementia wandering prevention. Mood: Alert, gentle.

cards.power: The Sovereignty-Buff. Reminds the team the Silver-Wrestler is a Veteran who chooses their own Care-Moves.
cards.lore: Promoting autonomy. Respecting a Wrestler's Will reduces Attrition-Fight and boosts Quality-of-Life-Stats.
cards.gradeReason: Advocating for elder autonomy is crucial but needs geriatric ethics context to fully embody the role.
cards.artworkPrompt: Silver stag standing proud in a hospital room, care team deferring respectfully to his stated wishes. Style: MedKayfab noble. Subject: Geriatric autonomy. Mood: Dignified, empowering.

cards.power: The Pain-Banish-Move. Stops the Fight-for-Cure and begins the Fight-for-Comfort for the Final-Round.
cards.lore: Quality of life. When the Healing-Clock runs out, Stats change from Survival-Length to Comfort-Depth.
cards.gradeReason: The paradigm shift from cure to comfort is immediately felt — a profound, embodied role change.
cards.artworkPrompt: Dove dropping its fight-for-cure sword, picking up a comfort shield instead, turning toward a setting sun. Style: MedKayfab poignant. Subject: Transition to palliative care. Mood: Peaceful, purposeful.

cards.power: The Airway-Calm. Uses a Cool-Breeze and Small-Blue-Ally-Meds to tell the Brain-Bunker it's okay to breathe slowly.
cards.lore: Terminal dyspnea. A Simple-Fan on the face is often a stronger Power-Move than an Oxygen-Tank.
cards.gradeReason: Point a fan at the dying patient — the disarmingly simple intervention is immediately and movingly clear.
cards.artworkPrompt: Sloth nurse gently directing a cooling fan at a breathless patient, breeze visibly calming their face. Style: MedKayfab quietly powerful. Subject: Terminal breathlessness. Mood: Tender, surprising simplicity.

cards.power: The Silence-Guard. Stops the Rattle-Sound so the Family-Team isn't terrified by the noise of the Final-Round.
cards.lore: Reducing secretions. It heals the Family's Mind-Armor, as the Wrestler is usually asleep.
cards.gradeReason: Protecting the family from the death rattle — immediate, human, profoundly embodied.
cards.artworkPrompt: Purple bat creature silencing throat secretion sounds with medication, a family exhaling with relief behind them. Style: MedKayfab compassionate. Subject: Terminal secretion management. Mood: Hushed, merciful.

cards.power: The Never-Alone-Buff. Stays in the Ring for the Final-Bell so the Wrestler doesn't face the Void alone.
cards.lore: Compassionate presence. The ultimate duty of the Care-Strategist is to witness the End-of-Story with respect.
cards.gradeReason: Stay with the dying patient. The most human, most embodied, most unforgettable card in the entire corpus.
cards.artworkPrompt: Dog nurse sitting quietly at a patient's bedside through the night, holding vigil, refusing to leave. Style: MedKayfab deeply human. Subject: End-of-life presence. Mood: Profound, still, irreplaceable.

cards.power: The Data-Burst. Compresses Match-Chaos into a Precise-Logic-Burst for the Physician-Detective.
cards.lore: Standardizing communication. Defeats arena Noise and ensures Clear-Signals are heard.
cards.gradeReason: SBAR is known by every nurse but the structure needs practice to embody spontaneously.
cards.artworkPrompt: Hawk swooping to a physician with compressed data scroll: Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation. Style: MedKayfab communication. Subject: SBAR handover. Mood: Efficient, precise.

cards.power: The Arena-Sync. A 5-minute Tactical-Meeting to ensure everyone is fighting the same Antagonist.
cards.lore: Reducing Information-Silos. Synced Team-Stats win more matches.

marketingText:
MedKayfab: NURSING & CARE – The Vigilance Vanguard (Medical Mnemonics Cut & Play Comic)

56 illustrated medical mnemonic cards to master the early-warning catch, the Code Blue response, and the death vigil nobody trained you to keep.

The doctor sees the patient for six minutes. You hold the watch for twelve hours. That is the whole job nobody puts on the poster: deterioration does not announce itself to the ward round, it announces itself to whoever is in the room when the breathing changes, the skin turns, and the patient who was fine an hour ago goes quiet in a way that is not sleep. The numbers crash last. By the time the monitor agrees with you, you needed to have moved already.

MedKayfab Nursing & Care puts that watch on the mat. Every assessment, every escalation, every quiet catch becomes a character with a tell and a clock, so the skill stops being a checklist you recite and becomes a face you recognize. Stop memorizing the observation chart. Start performing the catch.

YOU'LL GET
- 56 illustrated MedKayfab cards (14pp, 4 cards/page)
- Full MedKayfab Freestyle rules (Quest Die mechanics)
- S-Tier characters like Code-the-Final-Siren, Delirium-the-Reality-Warper, and Final-the-Vigil-Watcher
- Free lifetime updates as guidelines evolve
- CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence, print, share, and adapt freely
- PDF optimized for home printing (A4 / Letter)

What's in the deck
This deck personifies the part of medicine that never leaves the bedside. You will meet Code-the-Final-Siren, the cardiac-arrest call that turns a quiet room into a choreographed sprint where the order of your moves decides everything. Delirium-the-Reality-Warper is the acute confusion that rewrites the patient in front of you, the one everyone blames on old age until you trace it back to the infection or the drug that lit it. And Final-the-Vigil-Watcher is the deck's hardest character, the end-of-life watch where there is nothing left to fix and the entire skill is presence done well. From the first abnormal observation to the last breath, the deck covers the continuum the watch actually runs across.

How it works
Every card is a cognitive anchor built for high-stress retrieval. You have the Character (the mnemonic), the Visual (the scene), the Stat Block (the red-flag signs, the threshold, the first action), the Lore (the clinical story), and the Quest (the challenge at the bedside). The Mechanism Flash mode is brutal in nursing: if you cannot name the early warning and the escalation in one sentence without looking, the "patient" on the Stage crashes on someone else's shift.

Honest cognitive load
This is a high-yield core deck for nursing students and newly qualified nurses walking onto their first ward, and a fast refresher for anyone who learned this once and never got to feel it stick. It pairs naturally with Emergency Medicine for the Code Blue arc, Geriatrics for the falls, delirium, and palliative threads that run through every ward, and Pharmacology for the medication-safety catch that prevents half the harm before it starts.

ABOUT MEDKAYFAB
MedKayfab is a narrative medical learning card game, 50 decks covering the full medical curriculum. Every card encodes a clinical mechanism as a character with a personality, a story, and a reasoning challenge. Built by a physician. Assembled with AI tools. Manually revised. Honest about its limitations. Free to use, share, and adapt under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

PAY WHAT YOU WANT
This deck is Pay What You Want, including free. If you find it useful, a fair price is €5. If you are a student on a budget, enter €0, no questions asked. If you want to support more decks, anything above fair price is appreciated. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, share freely, attribute honestly, never resell.

DISCLAIMER
MedKayfab is a learning companion, not a clinical reference. Content was created by a physician and reviewed to the best of our knowledge, but medicine evolves, guidelines change, and some mechanisms in here will be simplified or wrong. Always verify against current primary sources and clinical guidelines before applying anything to patient care. The Blödsinn! is the vehicle. The science is serious.

Stay fluffy. — Doc FrizzleBob
